activity_overdue.action: Complete or reschedule the overdue activity
activity_overdue.why: The activity's planned date has passed and it is not complete.

assignment_returned.action: Decide what happens to the returned assignment
assignment_returned.why: The partner handed this assignment back, so the school still needs the support arranged another way.

core_assessment_missing.why: The core package cannot be planned until this financial year's core assessment is on file.

core_package_behind.action: Schedule the outstanding core visits and trainings
core_package_behind.why: The school's 4 visits + 4 trainings core package is not fully allocated for this financial year.

evidence_outstanding.action: Complete it with the Salesforce ID
evidence_outstanding.why: The activity was started but has not been completed with its Salesforce ID.

evidence_submission_stalled.action: Chase the partner to submit their evidence to IA
evidence_submission_stalled.why: The partner captured evidence but never submitted it, so IA cannot verify and the chain is stalled (§10: evidence goes directly to IA — there is no CCEO review stage).

ia_returned.why: Impact Assessment returned this activity and it has not been resubmitted.

intervention_critical.action: Act on the school's critical intervention area
intervention_critical.why: The school's weakest intervention area is in the Critical band.

intervention_follow_up.action: Follow up on the school's intervention areas
intervention_follow_up.why: The school's intervention areas need follow-up.

intervention_warning.action: Act on the school's weak intervention area
intervention_warning.why: The school's weakest intervention area is in the Warning band.

low_ssa.why: The school's SSA scores place it below the acceptable band.

no_ssa.why: No confirmed SSA exists for this school this financial year, so no intervention performance can be determined.

no_training.why: The school has had no completed training this financial year.

no_visit.why: The school has had no completed visit this financial year.

no_visit_or_training.action: Schedule the school's visit and training
no_visit_or_training.why: A verified SSA exists but none of the required support has been completed.

partner_delivery_escalation.why: Partner-delivered work has stalled and asking the partner directly has not moved it.

partner_not_scheduled.why: Work was handed to a partner who has not put a date on it.

partner_salesforce_overdue.action: Enter the Salesforce Activity ID for the partner's work
partner_salesforce_overdue.why: The partner's evidence is accepted but the activity has no Salesforce Activity ID, so it cannot be paid.

planning_cluster_gap.action: Put the school in an active cluster
planning_cluster_gap.why: The school has no active cluster, so it cannot be convened or trained with one.

planning_meeting_gap.action: Invite the school to a planned cluster meeting
planning_meeting_gap.why: The school is in a cluster but on no planned cluster meeting's roster.

planning_partner_gap.why: The school's Partner visit slots have not been handed to a Partner.

planning_school_gap.why: Some of the school's visit slots for the year are held by nobody — neither planned by staff nor handed to a Partner.

planning_training_gap.why: The school's training slots for the year are not all planned.

planning_visit_gap.action: Plan the school's outstanding staff visits
planning_visit_gap.why: Some of the visit slots staff are expected to deliver at the school this year have no staff visit planned.

repeated_reschedule.action: Review whether the plan is realistic
repeated_reschedule.why: The activity has been rescheduled repeatedly.

salesforce_missing.why: The activity is complete but has no Salesforce Activity ID.

scheduled_without_cost.why: The activity is scheduled but carries no cost line, so it cannot enter a fund request or a monthly budget.

team_costing_backlog.action: Get the team's scheduled work priced
team_costing_backlog.why: Scheduled activities in this team carry no cost, so they cannot enter a fund request.

team_execution_risk.action: Provide a recovery plan for the team's overdue work
team_execution_risk.why: Activities in this team are past their planned date and not complete.

team_partner_backlog.why: Several handovers in this team are waiting on partners to schedule them.
